Question 4

Consider the arc of the curve y=1−x that lies in the first quadrant between x=0 and its x-intercept. What integral gives the area of the surface generated when this arc is rotated 2π radians about the y-axis?

a
 π∫01x4x−5x−1dx
b
 2π∫01x4x−7x−1dx
c
 π∫02x2x−1dx
d
 2π∫01xx−1dx
e
 π∫024x−7x−1dx
